title: Agent run
description: A full agent turn composed from the parts: the user's request, reasoning, a plan, tool calls, an approval and the answer with sources — the pattern to copy for agent UIs.
when: Starting an agent chat or run log; shows how the AI parts sit together in a ChatList.
a11y: Order follows what happened; only the answer text is announced (ChatList), tool and reasoning details stay behind disclosures.
